description: Search the catalog of ready-made accounts (Telegram, TikTok, Gmail, Steam, ChatGPT and 70+ platforms) compared across independent shops. Returns matching platforms with their categories (slugs and URLs) and the most bought in-stock offers with price, stock, shop, product page and buy link (list_offers sorts one platform or category by price).

locale.description: Language of names and page links; also the price currency: ru = RUB, en = USD, de/es/pt = EUR, tr = TRY.

max_price.description: Maximum price per item in the locale currency.

platform.description: Platform slug to search within (from earlier results), e.g. "telegram".

query.description: Platform or product words, e.g. "telegram", "gmail aged", "tiktok ads".

name: search_accounts
title: Search account offers
